exclusions.name: FirstTrack courier
exclusions.why_safe: FirstTrack is the courier service used for document delivery. Its delivery times and pickup schedules are accounted for in the evidence (e7). Excluding the courier as an entity does not affect the causal steps because its performance is already described.

exclusions.name: Hollis Development
exclusions.why_safe: Hollis Development is the buyer entity, but its actions are fully represented by its principal Bram Hollis, who is included. Excluding the entity does not affect the causal chain.

exclusions.name: Kestrel Yard LLC
exclusions.why_safe: Kestrel Yard LLC is the seller entity, but its actions are fully represented by its principal Ada Fontaine, who is included. Excluding the LLC itself does not affect the causal chain.

exclusions.name: Renee Calloway
exclusions.why_safe: Renee Calloway is the escrow officer authorized to release funds, but her actions are part of Landmark's practice and are covered by the entity Landmark Title & Escrow. Excluding her individually does not change the outcome.
